role: Define string constants for semantic knowledge graph node and edge types in the Co-Being comprehension layer.
detail: Module defines 4 node type constants (CONVERSATION_CONTEXT, SEMANTIC_EDGE_TYPE, LOGICAL_AXIOM, DOMAIN_REGISTRATION) and 17 edge type string constants organized into 7 functional groups: taxonomic/property (IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, LACKS_PROPERTY), mereological/spatial (PART_OF, LOCATED_IN), functional/purpose (USED_FOR), causal/conditional (CAUSES, ENABLES, PREVENTS), action-schema (REQUIRES, ACHIEVES, PRODUCES, CONSUMES), epistemic/opposition (CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF), and cross-domain bridge (DENOTES re-exported from language_types). Each constant is documented with purpose, asymmetry flag, processing tier, and example. IS_A and PART_OF have associated transitivity axioms with confidence degradation rates (5% per hop for IS_A, 15% for PART_OF). DENOTES bridges LanguageDomain and SemanticDomain per CANON A.20. Zero semantic facts are pre-loaded; all knowledge earned through guardian teaching and sensor observation per CANON A.1.
gotchas: No stubs or TODOs. DENOTES is re-exported from language_types without redefinition per D4 from semantic-ontology decisions. HAS_PROPERTY instances carry property_type field with values sensory/functional/categorical reflecting Luria's three neuropsychological processing streams. Causal chain transitivity NOT applied automatically; requires deliberative reasoning per E5 inner monologue. PART_OF requires both edges with scope_context_count >= 2 before transitivity. Symmetric edges: CONTRADICTS, SIMILAR_TO, OPPOSITE_OF, DENOTES.
